excluded: Exclude 604-607 early_pruning held; 608/609 and formal exams untouched. Avoid 594/595 because retrospective return_response_learning/outside_pairs already used those public games. Previously exposed training development panels are extension truth, not held proof.
preselection: Each of the eight remaining different exposed source maps yields two possible root times per seat. Require |cash margin|<=1500 and |cash plus already-on-board feasible cargo difference|<=900. Feasible cargo is current own cargo with toroidal distance to a base <=remaining true transitions (upper bound; no future, no opposing actions). Rank by max(abs(cash), abs(cash+cargoDiff)), then mean of these absolute margins, then seed,t. Seat-balanced six maps: ordinal sequence 0,1,0,1,0,1. Give each ordinal the best ranked unused map for that seat, examine both scheduled times for the selected seat on that map if eligible in increasing rank; if both under fixed conditions have no admissible pair, keep failures and advance to next unused map for that seat. Never use a terrain twice, quota max3 per seat, max6 scored total.
root: Use native FULL original .58/T1 public policy of current online v2 8b4c4baf on all root recoveries and later continuations, versus original 65f268b2. Histories include both 8b4 and 7cf already-issued joint commands, written into each actor belief. Historical costs warmed first3 callbacks and private entropy replaced by shared reproducible roots. Policy RNG first4 SHA256 ASCII "{seed}/{seat}/{step}/close-returns-v1", opponent XOR 0x7d4a1f6b.
pair: Require own published native live winner in native same-depth H8 scored menu. A is native winner; B examined from top value and then menu index on ties. Require B differ on at least one collector with strictly positive cargo, with different resulting distance to nearest own base or a changed own-worker destination conflict. If feasible choose the highest scored such B. Prefer a separable home-direction effect; keep B rank, native full top-two status, margin values; any non-top-two pair is experimental extrapolation. Time/cargo/move mismatch left as abstention, no forced alternatives. Use no prospective model values to choose. Unseen currently responding opponent orders, history outcomes, actual game margin, experiment future hidden from selection; archived zip SHA binds bytes but those fields are not read by selector.
gate: Hash a single file with all native menus and endpoint-blind commitments from 7a1270e3 before the first terminal fork. Counterbalancing native/alternative order by ordinal, process fresh native opponent root once, both branches share it; all subsequent replies full online V2 and original .58/T1. Keep identity, seats and both map values for every branch; first 12 (or remaining) realizations labelled cash by both seats, delta official margin and terminal U per original squash. Also log actual delivery of units loaded at the root separately from all team deposits (deposit amount can include new pickup).
grade: Two observed real trajectories per accepted root, no further sampling to obtain positive pairs. Reference within-map paired rollout on shared host, no formal certificate; small pool exploratory. No independent test or submitted models.
